Actually, going 4 houses each (12 houses, $600) pushes rent to 400-450, leaving me only 2 houses in the bank for p2 and squeezing their housing options even harder. With my remaining cash plus mortgage potential across my other properties, I'd still have enough liquidity to survive landing on their greens, so I'll commit to the 4-each build plan.
